assertions: Manual content filter exposes original wiring pictures; combined query, brand, discipline and panel/device filters retain only matching source entries

Unmatched wording says no reviewed picture is indexed; it does not claim the equipment has no wiring
Selected picture displays its exact model scope, source title, edition and recorded PDF page; image path and dimensions match the curated source entry
Full-page source pictures retain the original captions, terminal labels and manufacturer conditions; all displayed gallery thumbnails are scrolled into view and decoded before capture
Fit and 150% zoom have no document horizontal overflow; new zoom/download controls and filter disclosure hit targets are at least 44 CSS pixels high
A deliberately failed source download leaves the picture usable and does not create a saved PDF
Normal download stores checked Sigma source bytes; its reader opens PDF page 11; Back to wiring picture preserves the query and saved-source action
Wrong saved PDF bytes with forged matching fileHash metadata are rejected for a source-page jump; the explicit open-from-beginning action opens page 1 only
Saved wiring scope contains only saved full-PDF parents; Recently saved puts newly downloaded Sigma ahead of retained Gent
Panel and device catalogue links use explicit curated target IDs and return only entries linked to the selected ID
Network-disabled reload opens the bundled wiring image, the newly downloaded Sigma PDF at page 11 and the earlier saved Gent PDF at page 1
PDF checks wait for nonblank, stable rendered canvas pixels, not only canvas allocation or a status label
The manual API interception is removed before offline checks; navigator.onLine is false; both viewports verify current sha256-v1 cache 57ad67801e89 with 1243 assets
Earlier synthetic fault visit, imported schedule, intruder settings, pack usage and actual 0.21 CFP/Sigma trainer records remain JSON-equivalent
The earlier Gent PDF retains its exact byte count and SHA-256; earlier Sigma/CFP trainer views and saved visit reopen
No browser page errors occur at either viewport
